# WebCodex v0.5.12

- Desktop clears the stale green Tunnel indicator when polling stops. It shows Tunnel polling and local MCP availability separately.
- The Tunnel reconnects faster when polling recovers in the same process. Recovery uses short polls and quicker retries after transport failures, with periodic longer polls for slow routes. It still honors the server’s `Retry-After` instructions.

## 中文

- 轮询停止后，桌面端会清除残留的绿色隧道连接提示，并分别显示隧道轮询状态和本地 MCP 的可用状态。
- 隧道在同一进程内恢复轮询时，重连更快。恢复期间会使用短轮询，传输失败后也会更快重试，同时定期使用更长的等待时间照顾慢线路。服务端发出 `Retry-After` 时，仍按其要求等待。
